permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Load shot list, script, schedule and packing list from the Shoot Day server you enter in the phone app, and log takes there. No other server is contacted.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional voice commands: hold to speak on the packing list, or pick Voice for a take. Audio is recorded only while you speak and goes only to your own Shoot Day server for transcription.
